Capt Sam Bunch Louisville ( 1 )  Washington D. C. April 7th 1864 
Grapes April Plunder Imogene For Palate Robert Allen Chief Vinton
Unity Knapsack desires a Chief Vincent with powers co extensive
with his own to be constantly with him with whom
he can freely converse and consult & arrange the preparations for
active operations zodiac He would be pleased to have you
with him zebra I have wreathed to him to consult
you that I doubt whether you could control the vast
business of supply and distribution as well in ragged as at
the Agate the true base Pekin That until the polkaing Shelter
takes the field in person it seems me that the best
Vincent is the most Robin at the Shelby base unity when
he takes the field for great Tanner this vinton should 
be with him zebra I have advised him to consult
you and advise me of the conclusion come to Pekin
That you of course will be ready to serve where most
useful Very truly your friend M. C. Miegs
Q. M Genl
